record.label: Endpoint-action hidden-state compression
record.summary: The complete G2 endpoint-action spectrum is terminally diffuse: rank13 retains only 2.4207%-20.0582% across 234 joint records, and no block reaches 70% by rank64. A separate 2,048-column CP3 screen likewise fails: self-energy selection is best at native-J MSE 2.5026e-7 and the marginal action proxy is 2.7710e-7, versus 2.8568e-8 for the full carrier. This closes retained original columns and the complete G2 directional carrier, not synthesized Tucker directions for the incumbent CP3 tensor.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for rank<=64 complete endpoint bases, original-column summaries, and higher-rank complete G2 directional carriers; Tucker recompression is a distinct scoped successor under G5.
